name: bitcoin-chart-2020-2026
description: Bitcoin daily candlestick film 2010-2026: neon hologram chart drawn in code, with a synthesized score.

scripts.stems: STEMS=1 node song.js && node engine/tools/levels.js out/music.wav out/stem-*.wav
scripts.build: node audit-asset.js && node check-event-sources.js && node make-data.js --strict && node song.js && node check-labels.js && FPS=60 node engine/render.js video && FPS=60 node engine/render.js mux && FPS=60 node engine/render.js check && FPS=60 node engine/render.js verify && FPS=60 node keep-render.js save final-$(date +%Y%m%d)
scripts.test:line: SHORT_STYLE=line COIN=DOGE FROM=2021-01-01 TO=2022-11-11 node make-data.js --strict && node line/test.js
scripts.test:equity: COIN=TSLA node make-data.js --strict && COIN=TSLA node --test test-equity.js
